transcript:
Advisor: Hi Maria, it's Sarah. Your message sounded stressed.
Maria: I need to wire $45,000 today. It's an emergency.
Advisor: Okay. Tell me what's happening.
Maria: James's equipment got held at customs and he has to pay a release fee before he can leave the platform. If it isn't paid by tomorrow he loses his contract and can't come home.
Advisor: Is the money going to James directly?
Maria: To a shipping agent he gave me. And I also need to move the rest of the money market into CoinVaultX. James says my account there is about to be frozen unless I add more to meet the minimum.
Advisor: Maria, a customs fee you pay to an agent and a platform that demands more money to unfreeze your account are both serious warning signs.
Maria: Please, there's no time for this. He's counting on me.
Advisor: Have you been able to withdraw anything from CoinVaultX so far?
Maria: Not yet. They said there's a withdrawal tax first.
Advisor: I'm worried about you. Can we bring Diego in on this?
Maria: No. Please don't tell Diego. He'd stop me, and James said not to tell anyone until he's home.
Advisor: I hear how much you care about James. I need some time to review a wire like this before it can go out. I'll call you back today.
Maria: It has to go today, Sarah.
